Diagnosis.submission: The custom-service deployment in the social-network namespace is broken. All 3 replicas are stuck in Init:0/1 because an init container named hang-init (image busybox:1.36, command /bin/sh -c "sleep infinity") was injected into the pod template. This init container never completes, so the custom-service-main container (python3 -m http.server 8080) never starts and the Deployment reports 0/3 available. All other social-network microservices are Running with healthy endpoints, so the root cause is the injected hang-init init container on custom-service, which must be removed.
